description: One two-state switch in 2HP, carrying an on voltage or an off voltage, driven by a button or an incoming gate or trigger

params.text: Switches the module on while it is held, or until the next press when its latch button is on
Makes the button beside it a toggle, one press switching on and the next off, in place of a state that lasts while the button is held
Chooses how the switching input is read: green treats it as a gate so the module is on while it is high, red treats it as a trigger that flips the state each time
Sets the on voltage, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and acts as an offset on the ON val input
Attenuates and inverts the ON val input between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Sets the off voltage, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and acts as an offset on the OFF val input
Attenuates and inverts the OFF val input between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%

inputs.text: Switches the module between its two states, read as a gate or as a trigger according to the button beside it
The signal carried while the module is on, added to the ON val knob after the trim
The signal carried while the module is off, added to the OFF val knob after the trim

outputs.text: Carries the on signal or the off signal, whichever state the module is in

notes: holding the button down forces the on state whatever the gate or trigger input is doing
the switching input reads channel 1 only, so a polyphonic signal is switched as a whole; Poly-Tweak Mk II is the one that switches channels separately
menu: Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V, leaving the ON val knob alone.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V, leaving the OFF val knob alone.
